data.field_desc: Create a new, empty tree structure.
Change the title of an existing tree (only the owner or a user with Admin permission can rename it) and assign it to one of your personal groups, including Archive.
Permanently delete an entire tree and all of its contents.
Create a copy of an existing tree using the Duplicate Tree button on its card.
Switch between your different trees to work on them. Also available from the root selector in the Tree Page header.

From JSON: Create a new tree by uploading a .json file.
From Archive (.zip): Create a new tree from a ZIP file, including the structure and all file attachments.
Create a new tree from a pre-defined example template.

nodes.name: Git Integration (requires valid token in user settings)

data.field_name_op: Git Integration (requires valid token in user settings)
data.field_desc:
Link to GitHub Repo: Connect an existing tree to a GitHub repository.
Create & Link Repo: Create a new repository on GitHub (optionally private) and link the tree to it automatically.
Unlink Repo: Disconnect a tree from its GitHub repository.
Commit: Save the current state of the tree as a new version in its linked repository.
Sync: Pull the latest version from the remote repository.
View History: Browse the commit history of a linked tree.
Restore to Commit: Revert the tree back to a previous version from the history.

Share Tree (People tab): Grant a registered user access to one of your trees, choosing permissions: Edit Nodes, Edit Templates, Admin (Admin includes the other two and allows renaming the tree).
Share with Team (Teams tab): Grant a whole team access with the same permissions.
Current Collaborators: Review who has access and adjust their permissions.
Revoke Share: Remove a user's or team's access to a shared tree.

Make Public: Turn on the 'Make Public' switch in the Share dialog to get a link that lets anyone view a read-only copy of the tree.
Initial View Mode: Choose how the link opens: Standard, Compact or Two-Panel.
Enable Explorer View: Allow viewers to drill down into specific nodes.
Copy Link: The chosen options are encoded in the link (view and explorer parameters).
The public link opens a read-only version of the tree at /view/<id>, with a public-view banner. Exporting from this view requires being logged in.
Drag and drop root cards to change their display order within the current view. Dropping a card onto a group pill moves it to that group instead.

Organize your roots in personal groups: filter pills at the top of the page (All Roots, Ungrouped, your own groups).
Manage Groups: Create, rename or remove groups.
Assign a root: Drag its card onto a group pill, or choose a Personal Group in Edit Tree.
Archive: Special group for roots you want out of the way; archived roots are hidden from 'All Roots' and from the tree selector (Move to Archive).
Add a new node to the top level of the tree.
Add a new node as a child of an existing node. The first 'Preferred Child Template' of the parent's template, if any, is preselected.
Add a new node directly after an existing node on the same level.
Open the form to modify a node's data.
Remove a node and all of its descendants.

Reorder: Change the position of a node among its siblings.
Reparent: Move a node to become a child of a different node.
Use the arrow buttons to move a node one position up or down among its siblings.

Copy: Copy a node (and all its children) to the clipboard.
Cut: Cut a specific instance of a node to move it elsewhere.
Paste as Child/Sibling: Paste the copied/cut node relative to another node.
Paste as Clone: Create a linked copy (a clone) of a node under another parent.
Paste Template: Open the Add Node dialog with the template of the copied node preselected, to create a new node of the same type (the copied data is not pasted).
Switch a node to use a different template, preserving data from fields with the same name.
Open the Template Designer on the selected node's template (from the node's right-click menu).
Mark a node as a 'favorite' for quick filtering.
Show or hide a node's children and content.
Recursively expand or collapse all descendants of a node.
Copy a special `node://` link to the clipboard for linking nodes together.

Assign: Pin a node to a number key from Node Menu > Link > Assign shortcut (and Clear shortcut to free the slot).
Use: Press 0-9 to open a quick overlay with that node (it also offers 'Open in Explorer'); press the same key again or Esc to close it.
Overview: The 'Node shortcuts' menu in the header lists all slots.
Scope: Slots are per user and per tree, and are carried along when a tree is exported and imported.
Open the Explorer dialog to view a node and its children in isolation. Use Previous Node, Parent Node and Next Node (and the breadcrumb) to move around; Print the view from the dialog.
Export a single node and all its descendants as JSON, HTML, or an Archive (.zip).

Right-click a node to open a menu with: Edit Template, Change Template, Export As (JSON, HTML, Archive), Copy, Cut, Link (Copy Link, Assign shortcut), Paste (as child, sibling, clone, template) and Delete.

Star icon: the node is a favorite.
Paperclip: the node has attachments.
Clone icon: the node is a clone; hover it to see all its other locations and click a location to jump to it.

Ctrl/Cmd+click: Add or remove a node from the selection.
Shift+click: Select a range of nodes.
Shift+Up/Down: Extend the selection with the keyboard.
The selection bar appears with the bulk actions; use 'Clear selection' to deselect.
Delete all selected nodes and their children.
Copy or cut all selected top-level nodes.
Edit the fields of several selected nodes at once in a single form based on their common template.
Apply a new template to all selected nodes simultaneously.
Expand or collapse all selected nodes.
Open the selected nodes together in the Explorer dialog (shortcut: v).
Export the selected nodes and their descendants as JSON, an HTML file, or a ZIP archive.
Design the structure of your nodes, including fields, naming rules, icons, and conditional formatting. Also reachable from a node via Edit Template.

Available field types: Text, Number, Date, Dropdown, Dynamic Dropdown, Text Area, Link, Checkbox, Checklist, Picture, Attachment, Table Header, Spreadsheet, XY Chart, Query, Kanban, Calendar, Embed, Markdown.

Node Name Template and Body Template build a node's title and body text from its fields.
Placeholders: {Field Name} inserts a field value; {count} and {count:N} insert child/descendant counts; {parent:Field}, {ancestor:Field:N} and {child:Field} insert values from related nodes.

Per field: Prefix and Postfix text, 'Same row as previous field' layout, dropdown options, and the column data type for Table Header fields.
Per template: Default Icon and Default Accent Color, conditional rules that change icon/color when a field matches a value (operator + value), and Preferred Child Templates (the first one is preselected in Add Child).
Remove a template (only possible if no nodes are using it).
Drag and drop templates to change their display order in selection dialogs.
Save or load a single template definition as a JSON file.
Save or load all templates for the current tree as a single .zip archive.
Copy selected templates from another of your trees into the current one.

Basic filters: Template, Date Created range, Date Modified range, Has Attachments.
Advanced queries: Add query groups that target a template and match rules on one of its fields (with operators), on an ancestor, or on a descendant.
Toggle a filter to view only favorite nodes (with their parents and descendants). Shortcut: s.
Undo/redo the last node actions (creation/copy, deletion, update, movement). Shortcuts: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y.
Toggle a number beside the node name indicating the order within its parent node. Shortcut: o.
Changes between single and double panel layout. In two-panel mode the right panel shows the details of the selected node, expanded according to the Auto-Expansion Depth setting. Shortcut: p.
Toggles between two different tree appearances with different node area footprint. Shortcut: Space.

When enabled, clicking a node name drills into it: only that node and its descendants are shown, and a breadcrumb trail lets you navigate back up. The last drilled node is remembered for the tree. Shortcut: x.
Export the current tree as JSON, an HTML file, or a ZIP archive.
Filters node containing the searched text in the name or in the body
Press r to reload the tree from the server. On shared trees the tree also refreshes automatically (about every 5 seconds) when another user saves changes.
For trees linked to GitHub: Commit Changes, View History (with Restore) and Sync from the Tree Page toolbar. Sync shows an update indicator when the remote has newer changes.
On small screens the search field collapses to an icon and toolbar actions (filters, favorites, numbering, compact view, export, Git) move into a menu. Some keyboard shortcuts are disabled.

Theme: Light, Dark or System.
Date Format: Choose how dates are displayed.
Number of levels automatically expanded when a node is shown in the two-panel details pane and in the node shortcut overlay (0 to 5).

Change Password: Update your password.
Active Sessions: Review your sessions and Revoke them.
Automatic Logout: Log out automatically after a period of inactivity.
Save the GitHub token used by the Git integration (link, commit, sync, history).
Create tokens (name, optional expiry date) and revoke them to authenticate programmatic access to the REST API. Available only when the server runs with ENABLE_API=true.
Interactive documentation at /api/v1/docs (Redoc at /api/v1/redoc, OpenAPI at /api/v1/openapi) for the /api/v1 endpoints on trees, nodes and templates; requests are rate limited.

Create Team / Rename Team: Teams can be shared trees with.
Member Directory: Add members and Apply Membership Changes.
Team Leaders: Leaders are set when creating a team; leadership roles are managed by administrators only, a team must always keep at least one leader and leaders cannot be removed from membership.
Create New User, Reset Password, Set as Administrator, and manage team associations.
Allow Public Sign-ups, Maximum Upload File Size (MB), Branding (custom SVG logo).
Review Storage Usage by User and clean up orphaned files.
Treelab can be installed as a Progressive Web App from the browser.
When the server runs with REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATION=false, login is disabled and the app runs as a single user.

Space: Compact view
s: Favorites filter
o: Show node numbers
r: Reload tree
p: Two-panel mode
x: Explorer view
(Space, o, p and x are disabled on mobile.)

e: Edit node
Enter: Add child
+: Add sibling
i / k: Move node up / down
*: Star / unstar
v: View in Explorer (Preview Selection)
t: Change template for the selection
Delete: Delete selection
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X: Copy / cut
Ctrl+V: Paste as child
Ctrl+Alt+V: Paste as clone (child)
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: Undo / redo

Up / Down: Move the selection
Shift+Up / Shift+Down: Extend the selection
Right / Left: Expand / collapse the selected node
Ctrl+Right / Ctrl+Left: Expand all / collapse all descendants
0-9: Open the node pinned to that slot (see Node Shortcuts (0-9)). Press the same key again or Esc to close the overlay.
